title: SensitivityProfile
description: A car's sensitivity profile as the dashboard shows it.

experiments.description: Finished one-item experiments the profile is built from.

labels.description: What the setup menu calls each item, by item id.

SensitivityEffect.title: SensitivityEffect
SensitivityEffect.description: What moving one setup item by some clicks does to one channel on this car: a pooled measurement, or a prior transferred from another car and flagged as one.

parameter.description: Item id in the game's setup.

clicks.description: Clicks moved; negative lowers the raw value. Never 0.

estimate.description: Variant minus baseline, in the channel's unit, per corner pass.

nonlinear.description: True when the item's other measured clicks show the response is not a straight line.

note.description: Why it is flagged non-linear, or how a prior was derived; empty otherwise.

is_prior.description: True when this was not measured on this car.

prior_source.description: Name of the car a prior was transferred from; empty for a measurement.

experiment_ids.description: The experiments the measurement is pooled from; empty for a prior.
